why.ru: Проекты принадлежат двум сёстрам, поэтому к форме мн. ч. «sisters» добавляется только апостроф после s: «sisters'».

stem.en:
In Feruza's neighborhood, keeping bees on the flat roofs of apartment buildings ______ become a popular hobby over the last few years.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The subject is "keeping bees", one activity; "on the flat roofs of apartment buildings" only says where. One subject takes "has".
why.uz: Ega — «keeping bees», bitta mashgʻulot; «on the flat roofs of apartment buildings» faqat qayerdaligini aytadi. Bitta egaga «has» mos.
why.ru: Подлежащее — «keeping bees», одно занятие; «on the flat roofs of apartment buildings» лишь говорит где. С одним подлежащим — «has».

stem.en:
Before the new road was built, the trip from the village to the city ______ almost a whole day; now it takes two hours.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The long trip belongs to the time before the road was built, a time already past, so the verb is "had taken"; "now it takes" is the present.
why.uz: Uzoq yoʻl yoʻl qurilishidan oldingi davrga tegishli, u allaqachon oʻtgan, shuning uchun «had taken»; «now it takes» — hozirgi zamon.
why.ru: Долгая поездка относится ко времени до постройки дороги — это прошлое, поэтому «had taken»; «now it takes» — настоящее.

stem.en:
Hoping to finish before the rain, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: the farmers worked late into the evening to bring in the apricots.
the apricots were brought in by the farmers late into the evening.
the work of bringing in the apricots went on late into the evening.
late into the evening was when the farmers brought in the apricots.

why.en: Only people can hope, so "the farmers" must come right after the comma; the apricots, the work and the evening cannot hope.
why.uz: Faqat odamlar umid qila oladi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin darhol «the farmers» kelishi kerak; oʻriklar, ish yoki kechqurun umid qilolmaydi.
why.ru: Надеяться могут только люди, поэтому сразу после запятой должно стоять «the farmers»; абрикосы, работа или вечер надеяться не могут.

stem.en:
The architect ______ plans for the new sports hall were chosen last month says the work will start in the spring.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The plans belong to the architect, so the owner word "whose" fits; "who's" means "who is", which makes no sense here.
why.uz: Rejalar meʼmorga tegishli, shuning uchun egalikni bildiruvchi «whose» mos; «who’s» — «who is» degani, bu yerda maʼno chiqmaydi.
why.ru: Планы принадлежат архитектору, поэтому нужно притяжательное «whose»; «who's» значит «who is», здесь это бессмысленно.

stem.en:
Rustam keeps a notebook of the birds that visit the feeder outside his kitchen window. For two years, he recorded sparrows there almost every morning. Last month, his neighbor adopted a cat that spends its mornings sitting on the fence beside the feeder. Since then, Rustam has seen almost no sparrows at the feeder in the mornings. Rustam can reasonably conclude that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: the cat on the fence may be scaring the sparrows away.
sparrows in his town have stopped eating seeds altogether.
the cat has caught every sparrow in the neighborhood.
sparrows only visit feeders that are far from any houses.

why.en: The sparrows stopped coming when the cat began sitting by the feeder, so the cat may be the reason; the other endings go beyond the text.
why.uz: Chumchuqlar mushuk yemlagich yonida oʻtira boshlaganidan beri kelmay qoʻydi, demak sabab mushuk boʻlishi mumkin; boshqa davomlar matndan tashqariga chiqadi.
why.ru: Воробьи перестали прилетать, когда кошка стала сидеть у кормушки, значит, причина может быть в ней; другие окончания выходят за пределы текста.

stem.en:
At a weekend market, Dilnoza sells two kinds of jam: apricot and cherry. On Saturday she set the apricot jars at the front of her table and the cherry jars at the back. The apricot jam sold out by noon, while most cherry jars were left. On Sunday she swapped them, putting the cherry jars at the front, and by noon the cherry jam had sold out instead. These results suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: where a jar stood on the table affected how quickly it sold.
shoppers at the market like cherry jam more than apricot jam.
Dilnoza made too little apricot jam for the weekend.
people buy more jam on Sundays than on Saturdays.

why.en: On both days the jam at the front sold out first, so the place on the table, not the flavor, most likely made the difference.
why.uz: Ikki kunda ham oldinda turgan murabbo birinchi tugagan, demak farqni taʼm emas, stoldagi joy keltirib chiqargan boʻlishi ehtimol.
why.ru: В оба дня первым раскупали варенье, стоявшее впереди, значит, разницу, скорее всего, дало место на столе, а не вкус.

stem.en:
The members of a school chess club noticed that they lost more games in the afternoon tournament than in the morning one, even against the same opponents. Their coach pointed out that the afternoon games began right after a long lunch break, during which most players ate a heavy meal and played football. The coach most likely believes that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: the players were too tired after lunch and football to play well.
the club's opponents practiced more in the afternoons.
chess games should never be played after noon.
the morning tournament used much easier rules than the afternoon one.

why.en: The coach points to the heavy meal and football right before the afternoon games, so he most likely thinks tiredness made the players lose.
why.uz: Murabbiy kunduzgi oʻyinlardan oldingi ogʻir ovqat va futbolni tilga oladi, demak u oʻyinchilar charchagani uchun yutqazgan deb hisoblaydi.
why.ru: Тренер указывает на сытный обед и футбол прямо перед дневными партиями, значит, он считает, что игроки проиграли от усталости.

stem.en:
Aziza's grandfather says that his old radio works only when it sits on the kitchen windowsill. When Aziza moved it to the living room, it played nothing but noise. When she carried it back to the windowsill, it played clearly again. Then she tried a new radio from the shop in both rooms, and it also worked only on the windowsill. These tests suggest that ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: the place, not the old radio, causes the problem.
the old radio is broken and should be replaced with a new one.
radios never work in living rooms.
the new radio from the shop is of poor quality.

why.en: Both the old and the new radio failed away from the windowsill, so the place, not the old radio, is the most likely cause.
why.uz: Eski radio ham, yangisi ham deraza tokchasidan uzoqda ishlamadi, demak sabab eski radio emas, joy boʻlishi ehtimol.
why.ru: И старый, и новый радиоприёмник не работали вдали от подоконника, значит, вероятнее всего, причина в месте, а не в старом радио.

stem.en:
In a class experiment, Bobur put one slice of bread in a closed plastic box and another slice, cut from the same loaf, on an open plate. Both stayed in the same room for five days. Mold appeared first on the slice in the closed box, which still felt soft and damp, while the slice on the plate had become hard and dry. Bobur's results suggest that the bread in the box grew mold first because ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: it kept more moisture than the slice on the plate.
it was cut from a different and much older loaf of bread.
the room was much warmer on the side where the box stood.
mold can never grow on dry bread.

why.en: The one difference the text reports is that the boxed slice stayed damp while the other dried out, so moisture most likely let mold grow first.
why.uz: Matnda aytilgan yagona farq: qutidagi boʻlak nam qolgan, boshqasi qurigan, demak mogʻor avval chiqishiga ehtimol namlik sabab boʻlgan.
why.ru: Единственное отмеченное различие: кусок в коробке остался влажным, а другой высох, значит, плесень быстрее появилась, скорее всего, из-за влаги.

stem.en:
Every evening, Mohira's grandmother sets a fourth plate on the table, although only three people live in the house. Mohira once asked why, and her grandmother said that a guest can arrive at any hour and should never find the table unready. Last night a neighbor knocked during dinner, and Mohira was not surprised to see her grandmother simply point to the empty chair. The grandmother's habit most likely shows that she ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: believes a home should be ready for guests at any hour.
expects the neighbor to come to dinner with them every single evening.
does not remember how many people live in her house.
prefers eating with guests to eating with her own family.

why.en: Her own words say a guest can come at any hour and should find the table ready, so the extra plate shows she wants to be ready for guests.
why.uz: Buvining oʻzi mehmon istalgan soatda kelishi mumkin va dasturxon tayyor boʻlishi kerak, deydi; ortiqcha likopcha mehmonga tayyor turish istagini koʻrsatadi.
why.ru: Бабушка сама говорит, что гость может прийти в любой час и стол должен быть готов, поэтому лишняя тарелка показывает готовность принять гостя.

stem.en:
To find out whether students at her school wanted a longer lunch break, Malika handed out a survey at the end of the chess club's after-school meeting. Almost every student who answered said the lunch break was long enough. Her principal pointed out that chess club members spend their lunch break in the library playing chess, while most other students eat in the canteen, where the lines are long. Based on the text, Malika's survey results ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: may not show what most students at the school actually think.
show that the lunch lines in the canteen are not really long.
prove that the whole school is happy with the lunch break.
suggest that chess club members eat more slowly than other students.

why.en: Only chess club members answered, and their lunch is unlike most students' lunch, so the results may not show what the whole school thinks.
why.uz: Faqat shaxmat klubi aʼzolari javob bergan, ularning tushligi esa koʻpchilikniki kabi emas, shuning uchun natija butun maktab fikrini koʻrsatmasligi mumkin.

stem.en:
Farmers in Otabek's village say that an apricot tree gives a good harvest only if it was pruned in late winter. They add that pruning does not guarantee a good harvest, since a tree can still do poorly in a dry summer. If the farmers are right and Otabek's apricot tree gave a good harvest this year, it follows that the tree ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: must have been pruned in late winter.
had a wet summer this year.
will give a good harvest again next year.
was the only tree in the village to be pruned.

why.en: Pruning is needed for a good harvest, so a tree with a good harvest was pruned. A dry summer only can hurt a tree, so a wet summer does not follow.
why.uz: Yaxshi hosil uchun butash shart, demak yaxshi hosil bergan daraxt butalgan. Quruq yoz faqat zarar berishi mumkin, shuning uchun yoz nam boʻlgani kelib chiqmaydi.
why.ru: Обрезка нужна для хорошего урожая, значит, дерево с хорошим урожаем обрезали. Сухое лето лишь может навредить, поэтому влажное лето из текста не следует.

stem.en:
A teacher wanted to know whether playing quiet music during tests helps students. In the first week, her morning class took a test with music, and her afternoon class took the same test in silence. The morning class scored higher. Later, however, the teacher noticed that her morning class had always scored higher than her afternoon class, even on tests taken in silence. This means that the higher morning scores ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: do not show by themselves that the music helped.
prove that quiet music improves test scores.
show that afternoon tests should be made easier.
mean that music made the test harder for the afternoon class.

why.en: The morning class always scored higher, even in silence, so its higher score this time may have nothing to do with the music.
why.uz: Ertalabki sinf jimlikda ham doim yuqoriroq ball olgan, shuning uchun bu safargi yuqori ball musiqaga bogʻliq boʻlmasligi mumkin.
why.ru: Утренний класс всегда набирал больше, даже в тишине, поэтому его более высокий балл на этот раз может быть никак не связан с музыкой.

stem.en:
The town library began closing at 9 p.m. instead of 6 p.m. on weekdays. In the following months, the number of visitors after 6 p.m. rose sharply, and most of the evening visitors were people who had never borrowed a book there before. The number of daytime visitors stayed about the same. The new evening hours most likely ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: drew in people who had not borrowed books there before.
made the library less popular during the daytime.
were used mostly by people who already visited every day.
caused the library to lose money on lighting and heating.

why.en: Evening visits rose, most evening visitors had never borrowed a book there, and daytime numbers held steady, so the new hours mostly drew in new people.
why.uz: Kechki tashriflar oshdi, kechki kelganlarning koʻpi u yerdan hech kitob olmagan, kunduzgi son esa oʻzgarmadi: yangi soatlar asosan yangi odamlarni olib kelgan.
why.ru: Вечерних посетителей стало больше, большинство из них раньше там книг не брали, а днём число не изменилось: новые часы привлекли в основном новых людей.

stem.en:
Kamola noticed that the tomatoes in the sunny half of her family's garden ripened about a week earlier than those in the shaded half, and she thought the extra sunlight was the reason. Her older brother suggested a different explanation: the sunny half had been planted a week earlier. Kamola checked the family's planting notes and found that both halves had been planted on the same day. If the notes are accurate, her brother's explanation ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: cannot explain the earlier ripening in the sunny half.
shows that sunlight has no effect on how tomatoes ripen.
is correct, because the sunny half ripened first.
proves that the shaded half was planted a week later.

why.en: Her brother said the sunny half was planted first, but the notes show both halves were planted the same day, so his idea cannot explain the difference.
why.uz: Akasi quyoshli qism oldinroq ekilgan degan, lekin yozuvlarga koʻra ikkala qism bir kunda ekilgan, demak uning fikri farqni tushuntira olmaydi.
why.ru: Старший брат решил, что солнечную половину посадили раньше, но по записям обе половины посадили в один день, значит, его объяснение не подходит.
